paite: Huchi in Solomon in TOUPA' inn ding alamzou vekta a; Solomon in apa David in thil ana latsa tengteng alalut a, dangkasik, dangka-eng, vanzat tengteng Pathian inn a goukoihna ah akoihta hi.
heading: Thukhun Bawm Tempul A Laklutna / (1 Kum 8.1-9)

paite: Huchi in Solomon in Israel upate, anam intekte, Israel suante inkuan makaite tengteng, David khopi Zion a kipan TOUPA thukhun bawm zawngtou ding in Jerusalem ah akaikhawm hi.
Huchi in Israel mi tengteng akha sagihna a ankuangluina ah kumpipa kiang ah ahohkhawm uhi.
Israel upate tengteng ahong ua, Levite'n bawm azawng uhi.
Huchi in TOUPA bawm leh kihoupihna biakbuk leh puanin a tui-um belsuan siangthou tengteng azawngtou ua; siampu Levite'n azawngtou uhi.
Kumpipa Solomon leh Israelte omkhawm tengteng akiang a hong kikhawmte bawm ma ah a-omkhawm ua, belam leh bawngtal gen seng vual louh leh sim seng vual louh in akithoih uhi.
Huchi in siampute'n ToUPA thukhun bawm a-omna ding ah alalut ua, insung a biakna mun, Mun Siangthoupen ah, cherubte kha nuai ah.
Cherubte'n bawm omna tung zawn ah akha uh azak gige ua, cherubte'n bawm leh azawnna chiangtawnte akhuh vek uhi.
Azawnna chiangtawnte asau mahmah a, azawnna chiangtawnte kongte biakna mun mai, Mun Siangthou a kipan in amuh theih a; himahleh polam ah zaw adawk kei: tutan huai ah a-om nilouh hi.
Aigupta gam a kipan apawt ua, TOUPA'N Israel suante kiang a thu akhun lai Mosi in Horeb tang a suangpek nih akoih kia lou ngal huai bawm sung ah bangmah dang a-om kei hi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, siampute Mun Siangthou a kipan a ahong pawttak un, siampu omte tengteng akisiangsak ua, apawl in akibawl tuan kei ua;
heading: TOUPA Thupina

paite: Levi lasami tengteng leng avek un, Asaph, Heman, Jeduthun, atapate uh leh a-unaute uh toh, puanmalngat silh a kivan in dakkhutbette, pekgingte, kaihgingte toh, maitam suahlam sang ah adingh ua, alak uah siampu za-le-sawmnih pengkul mut in a-om lai uhi.

Huan hichi ahong hi a, pengkul mutte leh lasa mite'n TOUPA phatna leh kipahthu genna dia atumging uh ging khat bang mai in akiza a; pengkul leh dakkhutbet leh thil tumging toh a-aw uh asuah ua: "Amah lah ahoih ngal a; azahngaihna tangtawn a om ding ahi ngal a," chi a, TOUPA aphat uleh, meipi in TOUPA' inn akhuhdim meuhmouh hi.
Huchi in meipi ziak in siampute'n nna asem theita kei ua; TOUPA thupina in Pathian inn adim vek hi.
